site.footerNoteEn: Your data stays on your device by default.

works.subZh: 从屏幕边缘拉出来的访达侧栏
works.taglineZh: 贴在屏幕边缘的抽屉：拖进文件夹就能翻看，剪贴板自动收着，随手记一个快捷键唤出。
works.taglineEn: A drawer docked to the screen edge — drop in folders to browse, clipboard kept for you, quick notes on one shortcut.
works.descZh: 不用离开手头的事，也不用切到访达。从屏幕边缘一拉，文件夹、剪贴板和随手记都在同一个侧栏里：文件夹能直接翻看、搜索、收藏成常用目录，网格与列表两种看法随手切；剪贴板把复制过的图片、链接、文件按类型分开存着，翻回去就能重新复制；想到什么按 ⌃⌘N 记一笔，写完自动落盘。原生 SwiftUI + AppKit，菜单栏常驻，面板可固定也可随手收起。
works.descEn: No need to leave what you're doing or switch to Finder. Pull the drawer from the screen edge and folders, clipboard history and quick notes all live in one sidebar: browse, search and pin folders as favourites, switching between grid and list at will; the clipboard keeps images, links and files sorted by type so you can copy them back later; hit ⌃⌘N to jot something down and it saves itself. Native SwiftUI plus AppKit, always in the menu bar, pinnable or dismissed on a whim.
featuresZh: 屏幕边缘抽屉，一拉即出
文件夹网格 / 列表双视图与搜索
常用目录收藏，路径直达
剪贴板历史自动收集（图片 / 链接 / 文件）
⌃⌘N 全局随手记，自动保存
菜单栏常驻，面板可固定
featuresEn: Grid and list folder views with search
Clipboard history for images, links and files

works.subZh: 跟着 Apple Music 滚动的歌词
works.taglineZh: Apple Music 唱到哪，桌面就滚到哪：半秒读一次播放位置，同步歌词从网上取回来，当前那句放大加粗、留在屏幕中间。
works.taglineEn: Whatever Apple Music is playing, the desktop scrolls along: the player position is read twice a second, synced lyrics fetched online, the current line enlarged and held mid-screen.
works.descZh: 桌面上浮着一块没有边框的歌词板：上一句压暗、当前句白得发亮、下一句在前面等着，滚到中间就停住。播放状态来自 Apple Music 的 AppleScript 接口，每 0.5 秒问一次歌名、歌手和播放位置；歌词先按「歌名 + 歌手」去 lrclib.net 精确匹配，匹配不上再退一步只按歌名模糊搜，拿到带时间轴的 LRC 后按秒数对齐，唱到哪句就亮哪句。字号、非当前句字号、歌词框高度都在设置里，摆哪儿、放多大由你。只认 Apple Music，也只做一件事：把正在放的那首歌，摊开在桌面上。
works.descEn: A borderless lyric board floating on the desktop: the previous line dimmed, the current one bright white, the next waiting ahead, and it scrolls to hold the middle. Playback state comes from Apple Music's AppleScript interface — track, artist and position asked for every half second. Lyrics are matched exactly by title and artist against lrclib.net, falling back to a looser title-only search; once a timed LRC comes back, lines are aligned by the second and lit as they are sung. Font sizes and the height of the lyric box live in Settings, so you decide where it sits and how big it gets. Apple Music only, and one job only: laying the song that is playing out on the desktop.
featuresZh: 0.5 秒轮询 Apple Music 播放状态
按歌名 + 歌手取同步歌词，失败转模糊搜
LRC 时间轴对齐，当前句高亮居中
上一句 / 下一句压暗，视线不乱
字号、非当前句字号、歌词框高度可调
无边框悬浮，菜单栏常驻、不占 Dock
featuresEn: Playback polled from Apple Music every 0.5s
Synced lyrics by title and artist, then a looser search
LRC timeline alignment, current line lit and centred
Neighbouring lines dimmed to keep the eye still
Font size, inactive size and box height adjustable
Borderless overlay, menu bar resident, no Dock icon

works.subZh: 把截图读成一条滚动播报
works.taglineZh: 桌面下沿一条不停的字幕：微信截图拖进去，系统 OCR 当场认字，按当年第几天每天挑十张轮播，一个月不重样。
works.taglineEn: A subtitle that never stops along the bottom of the desktop: drop a screenshot in, on-device OCR reads it, ten a day picked by the day of the year — no repeats for a month.
works.descZh: 不想专门打开阅读软件的时候，就让它挂在桌面下沿。图片往滚动条上一拖，Vision 当场认出文字、追加进当天的播报列表；启动时它自己去「文稿 / 微信记录截图」里按当年第几天挑十张，十张轮完再来一轮，一个月不重样。滚动条没有边框，按住背景就能挪到屏幕任意位置；右键能暂停、隐藏内容、退出。控制面板里调滚动速度（px/s）、看识别进度、点开任一条改文字、删掉不想要的。识别只在本机跑，图片不出门。
works.descEn: For the days you cannot be bothered to open a read-later app, park this along the bottom of the desktop. Drop an image on the ticker and Vision reads it on the spot, appending the text to today's list; at launch it picks ten screenshots from Documents/微信记录截图 by the day of the year, cycling through and starting over — a month before anything repeats. The bar is borderless: hold the background and drag it anywhere. Right-click to pause, hide the content or quit. The panel adjusts scroll speed in px/s, shows OCR progress, and lets you edit or delete any single item. Recognition runs on device; the images never leave.
featuresZh: 拖图片即识别，走系统 Vision OCR
按当年第几天每天轮播 10 张
无边框悬浮，按住背景随意拖
右键暂停 / 隐藏内容 / 退出
面板可调滚动速度、改文字、删条目
package.sh 一键出 .app、图标与 zip
featuresEn: Drop-in OCR via the system Vision framework
Ten screenshots a day, chosen by day of year
Borderless overlay, draggable from the background
Right-click to pause, hide or quit
Panel for scroll speed, text edits and deletions
package.sh builds the .app, icon and zip in one go

works.subZh: 乒乓球打卡与装备日志
works.taglineZh: 专注乒乓球日常打卡、装备日志与物理情绪球池的轻量 iOS 应用。
works.taglineEn: A hand-drawn ping pong tracker and gear companion, with a physics mood pool.
works.descZh: 拒绝冰冷单调的数字表格。「乒球人」把每一次练习、战术碰撞与对局大胜，化为沉降在物理球池里的一颗颗手绘乒乓球。胶皮什么时候该换、这个月的胜率怎么走，都能一眼看到。
works.descEn: No cold spreadsheets. Pongie turns every practice session and every hard-won match into hand-drawn ping pong balls settling into a living physics pool — built on SpriteKit with real gravity, collision and haptics.
featuresZh: 手绘物理「情绪球池」打卡
胶皮寿命与磨损提醒
胜率、打法分析与月度热力网格
6 款桌面与锁屏小组件
featuresEn: Six home and lock screen widgets
works.appStoreNote: 占位链接（由 ASC 记录 ID 拼出，待替换为真实商店地址）

works.taglineZh: 不被待办绑架，随手收藏心动。轻点手机背面两下，截屏瞬间静默入库。
works.taglineEn: Break free from to-do anxiety — double-tap the back and screenshots slip silently into your vault.
works.descZh: 每次看到好东西，第一反应是截图。然后截图躺进相册，再也没打开过。Dotney 想做的是第三件事：AI 本地把截图归类成书影音、金句、设计、地点等 12 大类，变成扇形堆叠的卡片，像翻一本实体画册。没有红点，没有死线，没有「你已逾期 3 天」。100% 本地运行，一张截图都不上传。
works.descEn: You screenshot something good, and it dies in your camera roll. Dotney does the third thing: on-device AI files it into one of 12 tags, and your collection becomes fan-stacked cards you actually flip through. No badges, no deadlines, no "overdue by 3 days". Vision OCR and speech run entirely on device — not one screenshot leaves your phone.
featuresZh: 瞬移截屏收藏（轻点背面即可）
12 大标签与扇形卡片堆叠
「去待办」设计哲学：不催你
100% 纯本地，Vision OCR + Speech
works.lineageZh: 前身沿革：ScreenshotTodo → 心光手记 → 小布 Journey → Dotney
works.lineageEn: Lineage: ScreenshotTodo → MindLight → Xiaobu Journey → Dotney

works.taglineZh: 截屏，即是待办。本地智能识图，锁屏即刻同步。
works.taglineEn: Screenshot it — it's already a to-do. On-device OCR, synced straight to your Lock Screen.
works.descZh: 看到该做的事，先截个图。App 在本地解析截图里的文字与来源应用，直接生成待办并同步到系统提醒事项，锁屏实时活动一直挂在眼前。全程本地识别，图片不上传。
works.descEn: Spot something you need to do? Just screenshot it. The app reads the text and source app on device, turns it into a to-do, and syncs it to Reminders. A Live Activity keeps it on your Lock Screen.
featuresZh: 极速截图触发
本地智能 OCR 解析
系统级原生同步（提醒事项）
锁屏实时活动

works.taglineZh: 家里那几道菜的步骤、用量和买菜清单，一处记清。
works.taglineEn: The recipes your family actually cooks — steps, amounts and a shopping list in one place.
works.descZh: 把常做的菜记成一份自己的菜谱：用量、步骤、准备时间都写清楚。要买菜时说一声「点菜」，清单自动汇总；做完还能回头翻时间轴，看看这个月都吃了什么。手表上也能看下一步该做什么。
works.descEn: Turn the dishes you cook often into your own cookbook — amounts, steps and prep time, all written down. Order what you want to eat and the shopping list builds itself. A timeline keeps a record of what you've actually made.
featuresZh: 点菜式下单与买菜清单
分步引导，做菜时不慌
时间轴回顾做过的菜
watchOS 表上查看步骤

works.taglineZh: 在碎片中，整理思绪 —— 一款为碎片化灵感而生的极简笔记工具。
works.taglineEn: Capture ideas — a minimalist note tool built for fleeting thoughts.
works.descZh: 打开应用，直接在底部的无限草稿纸上写。写完点一下上方的分类方块，一键归档，没有多余操作。预设 36 个思维维度，覆盖心理、商业、艺术等方向，随时可以重命名。极致黑白美学，配一张方块轨迹图，看你在各个领域想得有多活跃。
works.descEn: Open the app and write straight onto the infinite draft paper at the bottom. Tap a category block to file it instantly — zero friction. 36 preset dimensions cover psychology, business, art and more, all renameable. A stark black-and-white aesthetic with a block-trail chart showing where your thinking is most alive.
featuresZh: 先写后归，一触即达
36 个可重命名的思维维度
极简黑白美学
方块轨迹图，看清思考活跃度

works.taglineZh: 探索你的人际星系 —— 伴侣共享日历与成长记录。
works.taglineEn: Explore your social galaxy — a shared calendar and growth log for two.
works.descZh: 把认识的人、一起做过的事和攒下的谈资，画成一张银河人际星图。双端伴侣同步与共享日历、疫苗接种提醒与成长记录、给未来写一封信的时空胶囊，还有社交词频与互动分析。全部数据留在你自己的 iCloud 里。
works.descEn: Everyone you know, everything you've done together and every topic you've banked — mapped into a galaxy. Two-device partner sync, a shared calendar, vaccination reminders and growth records, time capsules to your future selves, plus word-frequency and interaction analysis.
featuresZh: 银河人际星图
双端伴侣同步与共享日历
疫苗接种提醒与成长记录
时空胶囊（给未来的信）
社交词频与互动分析
featuresEn: A galaxy map of your relationships
Two-device partner sync and shared calendar
Time capsules — letters to the future

works.taglineZh: 一页跑完一周，没做完的自动滚到下一周。
works.taglineEn: One page per week — whatever isn't done rolls into the next one.
works.descZh: 照子弹笔记里那条「Running List」的做法做的：一周一页，做完的打勾，没做完的留下来继续。纸张主题和背景网格都能换，写起来更像真的手帐。
works.descEn: Built the way a bullet journal running list works: one page per week, check things off, and carry the rest forward. Swap paper themes and background grids so it feels like a real notebook.
featuresZh: 滚动周清单，未完成自动顺延
手帐纸张主题
背景网格可选
状态标记：完成 / 迁移 / 放弃
featuresEn: Rolling weekly list with auto carry-over

works.taglineZh: 用吃、心情和器官养护，把大脑一点点练回来。
works.taglineEn: Rehab your brain with food, mood and organ care — one check-in at a time.
works.descZh: 每天记下吃了什么、心情如何，配一个陪着你的脑精灵。补给、共享餐、器官养护几个视图把吃进去的东西和状态连起来看。
works.descEn: Log what you ate and how you felt, with a little brain sprite along for the ride. Supply, shared meals and organ-care views connect what you eat to how you're doing.
featuresZh: 今日补给打卡
脑精灵陪伴
共享餐记录
器官养护视图

works.taglineZh: 现场照着参考线拍，拍出你收藏的那种构图。
works.taglineEn: Shoot on site with overlay guides and match the composition you saved.
works.descZh: AI 分析构图并匹配推荐焦段，在取景框上画出手绘姿势骨架和参考线。也可以直接丢一条笔记链接进来，它会把构图、姿势线稿和情绪金句拆出来。
works.descEn: AI reads the composition, picks a recommended focal length, and draws hand-sketched pose skeletons and alignment guides over your viewfinder. Paste in a saved post and it pulls out the composition, the pose linework and the mood line.
featuresZh: AI 构图分析与推荐焦段
手绘姿势骨架线稿叠加
解析笔记链接提取参考线
情绪金句叠字
featuresEn: AI composition analysis and focal length

works.subZh: 产检记录与 AI 医嘱提炼
works.taglineZh: 记下历次产检医嘱，AI 帮你提炼成看得懂的重点。
works.taglineEn: Log every prenatal checkup; AI distills it into what actually matters.
works.descZh: 专为孕妈妈设计：记录历次产检医嘱与体征指标，自动整理成结构化总结、用药指南、饮食建议和跨产检期的趋势分析。另有 1–40 周产检路线图和胎动计数。数据完全保存在本地。
works.descEn: Built for expectant mothers: log each checkup's advice and vitals, and get a structured summary, medication guide, diet notes and cross-visit trend analysis in return. Includes a week 1–40 checkup roadmap and kick counting. Data stays on device.
featuresZh: 产检医嘱记录与结构化总结
1–40 周产检路线图
胎动计数
跨产检期趋势分析
数据本地保存

works.subZh: 把每次打开记成时间轴
works.taglineZh: 把「每次打开重点 App 用了多久」记成一条锁屏时间轴。
works.taglineEn: Every session on the apps you care about, drawn as a Lock Screen timeline.
works.descZh: 时间轴上的每个节点是一次打开，两个节点之间的线长就是这一次持续了多久，颜色跟着那个 App 的主题色走。常驻锁屏实时活动，不用打开应用也能看见今天怎么过的。
works.descEn: Each node on the timeline is one launch; the length of the line between two nodes is how long that session lasted, coloured by that app's own theme. A permanent Live Activity means you can see how the day went without opening anything.
featuresZh: 行为时间轴（线长 ＝ 时长）
锁屏实时活动常驻
会话闭合算法
按 App 主题色区分

works.taglineZh: 按当前时辰，看对应的脏腑与养生建议。
works.taglineEn: A watch-only clock that shows the organ and the advice for this hour.
works.descZh: 中医「子午流注」做成一块手表表盘：按当前时辰展示对应脏腑器官、养生建议与进度环。
works.descEn: Traditional Chinese medicine's meridian clock, rebuilt as a watch face: the organ for the current shichen, its advice, and a progress ring.
featuresZh: 时辰脏腑表盘
时辰养生建议
进度环

works.subZh: 抬腕就玩的体感小游戏
works.taglineZh: 抬腕就玩 —— 用 Apple Watch 手势投篮、打乒乓、射击。
works.taglineEn: Flick your wrist to shoot hoops, play ping pong or fire.
works.descZh: 用陀螺仪识别手势波峰，配空间音效与震动反馈。实时采样 AirPods 的九轴姿态角，动作幅度也能算进去。
works.descEn: Gyroscope peak detection drives the action, with spatial audio and haptics. AirPods nine-axis headphone motion is sampled live so head movement counts too.
featuresZh: 随时投篮 / 打乒乓 / 射击 / 自由击拳
AirPods 九轴姿态联动
空间音效与震动反馈
featuresEn: Hoops, ping pong, shooting, free boxing

works.subZh: 把每日所学沉淀成复利
works.taglineZh: 记录每日所学，沉淀成看得见的复利。
works.taglineEn: Log what you learn each day and watch it compound.
works.descZh: 从「记录 → 沉淀 → 显化 → 回顾」走一圈。顶部三个数告诉你连续了多少天、累计多少条、覆盖了哪些领域。断签了也不清零，只把「最长 41 天」摆在那里当参照。
works.descEn: Record, settle, surface, review. Three numbers up top: current streak, total entries, and the fields you've covered. Miss a few days and nothing resets — it just shows your longest run, 41 days, as a reference.
featuresZh: 一句话快捷记录
连续天数 / 累计条数 / 覆盖领域
断签不清零
沉淀与回顾视图
featuresEn: No reset when you miss a day

works.subZh: 自动分类的截图收藏 Demo
works.taglineZh: 按 OCR 文本与 #标签 自动分类的截图收藏 Demo。
works.taglineEn: A screenshot collection demo that auto-files by OCR text and #tags.
works.descZh: 早期的一个技术验证：识别截图里的文字与 #标签，自动归类，并提供堆叠与网格两种浏览方式。
works.descEn: An early technical prototype: detect the text and #tags inside a screenshot, file it automatically, and browse either stacked or in a grid.
featuresZh: OCR 文本与 #标签 自动分类
堆叠 / 网格两种浏览

works.taglineZh: 自动整理 B 站的历史记录、收藏夹与稍后再看，并把你真正关注的东西画成一条时间线 —— 从泳道密度到「什么时候开始看这个」，安装包与使用说明书都在这。
works.taglineEn: Organizes your Bilibili history, favourites and Watch Later — then draws it into an intake timeline, from lane density to when a topic first entered your view. Packaged build and manual included.

works.nameZh: 一键提炼与工作流助手
works.taglineZh: 鼠标悬停在文章、YouTube 或 B 站链接上，直接用大模型提炼精华、流程与用到的工具。
works.taglineEn: Hover any article or video link and let an LLM pull out the gist, the workflow and the tools used.

works.taglineZh: 随手截取网页上的图片和文字，以拼贴画的方式管理，一键复制到剪贴板。
works.taglineEn: Snip images and text off any page, keep them as collages, copy them all in one click.

works.nameZh: 看看收藏 · 单条导入
works.taglineZh: 只读你正打开的那篇小红书笔记，交给本地的「看看收藏」。全程不出这台机器。
works.taglineEn: Reads only the note you have open and hands it to the local Kankan app. Nothing leaves your Mac.

works.taglineZh: 指向 B 站、抖音、小红书或 YouTube 的视频，秒级认出它用了哪些剪辑、3D、编程与设计软件，并给出时间轴。
works.taglineEn: Point at a video and it names the editing, 3D, coding and design tools used — with a timeline.

works.taglineZh: 把小红书的收藏和点赞整理成真正能带走的数据 —— 打包好的安装包与使用说明书都在这，解压即可安装。
works.taglineEn: Turns your Xiaohongshu saves and likes into data you can keep. Packaged build and manual included — unzip and load.

works.taglineZh: 3D 物理球形鱼眼透镜矩阵画廊：收录 1925–2026 跨越百年的 3,200+ 期《纽约客》杂志封面，支持全景穿梭与一键复制大师级 AI 提示词。
works.taglineEn: A 3D fisheye lens matrix gallery archiving 3,200+ New Yorker covers across 1925–2026 with one-click AI prompt copying.

works.taglineZh: 把 App 截图做成 App Store 首图风格。纯前端、零依赖、不联网，打开就能用。
works.taglineEn: Turns app screenshots into App Store hero images. Pure front-end, zero dependencies, offline.

works.taglineZh: 用 macOS 桌面当隐喻的个人站 —— 菜单栏、Dock、专辑封面和 iPod 滚轮都在。
works.taglineEn: A personal site shaped like a macOS desktop — menu bar, Dock, album art and an iPod click wheel.

works.taglineZh: Creative Technologist & Motion Portfolio，2026 年版。
works.taglineEn: Creative Technologist & Motion Portfolio, 2026 edition.

works.taglineZh: 把好文章拆开、看清骨架、再重写一遍的创作工作台。
works.taglineEn: A studio that takes good writing apart, shows you the frame, then helps you rewrite it.

works.taglineZh: 把当天的心情，调成一杯能存下来的酒。
works.taglineEn: Mixes the mood of the day into a cocktail you can keep.

works.taglineZh: 把读过的书摞成一摞看得见的进度。
works.taglineEn: Stacks what you've read into progress you can see.

works.taglineZh: 手绘儿童动画：宇宙来的小使者笑笑，奉命与地球星人建交，在花园里学会友善与分享。入围「爱德说」幼儿德育作品征集活动（幼儿动画片组）。
works.taglineEn: A hand-drawn children's short: Xiaoxiao, a little envoy from outer space, is sent to make contact with Earthlings and learns kindness and sharing in a garden. Shortlisted in the "Aide Shuo" early-childhood moral-education works programme (animated-film category).

works.taglineZh: 手绘动画短片：第一次走进健身房，从办卡到面对满屋子器械的手足无措。获「花样塑颜视频大赏」二等奖。
works.taglineEn: A hand-drawn short about a first-timer at the gym — from signing up to facing a room full of machines. Second prize at the Huayang Shaping Video Awards.

works.taglineZh: 用 HTML 逐帧渲染再合成音频做出来的 App Store 预览片，886×1920，中英双语各一版。
works.taglineEn: An App Store preview built by rendering HTML frame by frame, then synthesising the audio. 886×1920, bilingual.

works.taglineZh: 实拍加字幕的短片剪辑，1920×1080，24 秒。
works.taglineEn: A shot-and-subtitled short edit. 1920×1080, 24 seconds.

works.taglineZh: 从截取、拼贴到复制，走一遍插件的完整流程。
works.taglineEn: The full loop of the extension: snip, collage, copy.

works.taglineZh: 用四分半钟走完整个作品集站点。
works.taglineEn: Four and a half minutes through the whole portfolio.

works.taglineZh: 用 Swift 逐帧渲染加语音合成做的 14 秒样片，1080×1440。
works.taglineEn: A 14-second sample rendered frame by frame in Swift, with synthesised narration. 1080×1440.

works.taglineZh: B 站 Collector 的功能演示：收藏一多，怎么自动归位。
works.taglineEn: A demo of Bilibili Collector — what happens once your saves pile up.

works.taglineZh: 把虎扑当日回复最多的帖子，洗成十条 60 秒、一句一屏的口播稿，抓榜到校验全自动。
works.taglineEn: Turns the day's busiest Hupu threads into ten 60-second voiceover scripts — one sentence per caption, scripted end to end.

works.taglineZh: 把「上传被拒」的红字报错，定位到具体是哪一条规格没过，并修好。
works.taglineEn: Turns a rejected App Preview upload into the exact spec that failed — then fixes it.

works.taglineZh: 批量产出 App Store 风格的产品首图和卖点图。
works.taglineEn: Produces App Store style hero and feature images at scale.

works.taglineZh: 用浏览器自动化把 App Store Connect 的内购项目创建并配好。
works.taglineEn: Creates and configures App Store Connect in-app purchases through browser automation.

works.taglineZh: 按 Apple 的规则审订阅页和买断页，把违规点逐条挑出来。
works.taglineEn: Audits subscription and one-time paywalls against Apple rules, line by line.

works.taglineZh: 编译并跑出真实截图来验证 SwiftUI 布局，不靠肉眼猜。
works.taglineEn: Compiles and captures real screenshots to verify SwiftUI layout instead of guessing.

works.taglineZh: HTML + GSAP 写分镜，无头浏览器逐帧渲染，直接出 H.264 成片。
works.taglineEn: Storyboard in HTML and GSAP, render frame by frame in a headless browser, get an H.264 film.

works.taglineZh: 从一段录屏里认出网站，还原界面，复刻成能跑的前端。
works.taglineEn: Identifies a site from a screen recording, rebuilds the UI, ships runnable front-end code.

works.taglineZh: 把任意网站的真实文案、路由结构、隐私条款和设计令牌摊开来看。
works.taglineEn: Lays out a site’s real copy, routing, privacy terms and design tokens for inspection.

works.taglineZh: 分清「文件有多大」和「删了能省多少」—— macOS 上这两件事常常不是一回事。
works.taglineEn: Separates "how big is it" from "how much would deleting it actually free" — rarely the same on macOS.

works.taglineZh: 把任务进度实时投到 MacBook 的刘海里。
works.taglineEn: Pushes task progress onto the MacBook notch in real time.

works.taglineZh: 自制 Siri intelligence —— 在 Mac 上截个图，直接问 Gemini，不用切窗口、不用复制粘贴。
works.taglineEn: Home-made Siri intelligence for the Mac: screenshot, then ask Gemini — no window switching, no copy-paste.
